title: Maximum Average Pass Ratio
statement:
Each class is `[passed, total]`. Assign each extra student to one class; each extra student passes. Return the maximum possible average pass ratio after assigning all extra students. Answers within `10^-5` are accepted.

## Examples

```text
Input: classes = [[1, 2], [3, 5], [2, 2]], extraStudents = 2
Output: 0.78333
```

```text
Input: classes = [[2, 4], [3, 9], [4, 5], [2, 10]], extraStudents = 4
Output: 0.53485
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= classes.length <= 10^5`
- `1 <= passed <= total <= 10^5`
- `1 <= extraStudents <= 10^5`
